# Minions.AI — Operational AI Voice & Dispatch System for Trade Contractors

> Minions.AI builds autonomous, low-latency AI voice agents and CRM dispatching systems specifically engineered for home-services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and pest control).

## Core Capabilities & Performance Benchmarks
- **Answering Latency**: Answers live phone lines in under 1.8 seconds (24/7/365).
- **Zero Missed Calls**: Prevents the loss of $2,500 to $4,500 emergency contractor jobs due to unanswered calls during field work.
- **Direct CRM Integration**: Real-time two-way sync with EspoCRM, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Google Calendar without fragile webhooks.
- **Accurate Address & Intent Extraction**: Trained on real contractor calls with background compressor noise, spotty basement LTE, regional accents, and urgent homeowner scenarios.
- **Deterministic Human Escalation**: Cleanly transfers complex or ambiguous inquiries to owner cell phones with full caller context instead of guessing or dropping calls.

## Live Callable Phone Demo
- **Live Test Line**: +1 (800) 555-0199
- **Demo Scenario**: Hear "Alex" answer as a live home-services company, qualify an emergency repair, check calendar availability, and confirm booking.
